scope: Pure portable native creation planner. It mutates no Lua state, live entities, runtime object registry, attachment transforms or physics.

api.entrypoint: bool planMapCreation(const vector<MapCreationRecord>&, const MapCreationContext&, MapCreationPlan&, string& error)
api.input: Resolved original payload identity/name, source Active, separate DoCreate presence, range flag/range/location, parent and ordered child IDs, original DataType, resolved optional PlayerControlled and Thing.TriggerOnSpawn.
api.context: EditingMode, world frame and optional first non-null PlayerManager player active-unit location, all explicit. No player/frame is invented.
api.output: Creation entries retain source ordinal, parent/depth, creation kind and definition TriggerOnSpawn gate. Deferred entries distinguish root source-inactive, root range-deferred and descendants waiting for deferred ancestor. Only root entries claim native inactive/range registration. Output is committed only after full validation/planning succeeds.

rules: AttachToID>0 records skipped in top-level loop
Source Active=false outside EditingMode -> inactive root
Range-enabled root needs first nonnull player with usable active-unit location, worldFrame>1, float squared distance<=ActivationRange squared; otherwise inactive/range root
Top-level DataType1 selects ObstacleManager, DataType2 gets original unit data and PlayerControlled selects player/non-player unit path
Pushes AttachedIDs in reverse, pops from back; original sibling order depth-first, parent before child
Child path directly uses ObstacleManager::Create; does not inspect child Active, ActivateAtRange or DataType
Then RemoveInactiveThing, parent AddChild and child OnParentAdded, before grandchildren
Planner rejects attached unit data explicitly because native unit-as-obstacle component initialization is not reconstructed
children.callback_gate_boundary: Sibling bounded static join: native-creation-obstacle-create-disassembly.txt VA0x1802c7f37 setsr8b=1 before Add VA0x1802c7f3f; child Create does not suppress Add OnSpawn request. Definition TriggerOnSpawn still applies. Planner records definition gate only; it executes no callbacks.

payload_presence.rule: DoCreate false means no serialized payload fields; native loader still allocates/defaults a MapThing. It is not Active=false and does not mean skip/delete.
payload_presence.planner_boundary: Absent payload cannot provide validated ID/name/type here, so planner fails explicitly for DoCreate=false instead of silently omitting or declaring inactive. No default-payload entity creation is claimed.

validation: Positive unique IDs and nonempty bounded identity names
Supported DataType and explicit resolved PlayerControlled for units
Finite original positions/ranges; negative finite range squared as native comparison does
Every ordered AttachedID exists exactly once and reciprocates AttachToID
Every AttachToID exists and its parent list includes the record
No duplicate child references, self-links or cycles (iterative coloring)
Every source record appears exactly once as creation or deferred accounting
ordering_boundary: Top-level order is explicitly caller source vector order. Native GroupManager::GetAllThings hash/enumeration order has not been equated to serialized source order; no native allocation/callback ordering fidelity claim. Ordered child DFS is recovered.

original_metadata.correction: v2 resolves21 omitted Breakable PlayerControlled valuesfalse using native compiled constructor/assignment proof and retains separate source omission/provenance.

observed_debug_result.validation: ASan/UBSan build and focused original-source metadata run clean. Checks parent-before-child, original child gate ignoring source inactive/range flags, malformed reciprocal edge, reciprocal cycle, absent payload and native range-frame/inclusive distance boundary.

not_reconstructed: Final native parent/child transforms and OnParentAdded effects
Live Active/inactive registry mutation or range activation update loop
Lua callback dispatch, yield handling or callback-driven changes to graph
UnitManager callback flags and exact OnSpawn arguments, owned by root investigation
Name overrides or other live map changes beyond explicit input metadata
